description: Telerik UI for WPF versions prior to 2026.4.1110 contain an untrusted URL redirection vulnerability. This flaw allows attackers to launch arbitrary operating system protocol handlers with attacker-controlled arguments by using crafted documents or hyperlinks with non-allowlisted URI schemes that a user opens. The vulnerability is fixed in version 2026.4.1110.
